mapper.select: select "BOARD_NUM" as board_num, "BOARD_TITLE"::text as board_title, "BOARD_WRITER" as board_writer, "BOARD_CONTENT" as board_content, "BOARD_DATE" as board_date, "BOARD_INT" as board_hit from "tb_qna" order by "BOARD_NUM" desc limit #{perPage} offset #{startNum}

select "BOARD_NUM" as board_num, "BOARD_TITLE"::text as board_title, "BOARD_WRITER" as board_writer, "BOARD_CONTENT" as board_content, "BOARD_DATE" as board_date, "BOARD_INT" as board_hit from "tb_qna" where "BOARD_NUM" = #{boardNum}
